content.text:
The data shows a clear sensor-fault signature for Zone_F3_Z01: starting around July 1 2018 the F3_Z01 sensor is stuck reading exactly 24.0°C across many consecutive daytime hours (7:00–16:00) every day (e.g., 2018-07-01, 2018-07-02, 2018-07-03 …), while the neighboring zones F3_Z02, F3_Z03, F3_Z05, and F2_Z02 do not exhibit this pinned-value pattern and vary smoothly around ~23–26°C. A stuck-value pattern at a round number is a classic sensor-failure signature that a genuine local heat-load change would not produce.

Answer: zone sensor fault.
